entities.summary: Ann-Louise Carina Edstrand is an ice hockey player from Sweden. She won a silver medal at the 2006 Winter Olympics and a bronze medal at the 2002 Winter Olympics. In 2016, she was elected to the Swedish Hockey Hall of Fame.
